Three partial main-text records preserve the explicitly stated Table S1 results: decent 3a without added water, stopped conversion at 100 equiv H2O, and 5 mol% TfOH/60 °C giving 2a 88% plus 3a 12% after an unstated extended time. No SI association or unstated condition was inferred.

regions.finding: A distinct 2a/H2O/TfOH experiment in toluene at 100 °C for 2 h gives 3a in 97% isolated yield, supporting 2a as the key intermediate.

The sequential one-pot 1j→2j→3j-18O experiment was retained as one two-step record with two ordered 100 °C/12 h stages, direct second-stage additions, 75% two-step yield, and 56.6% 18O incorporation.
